ai_calls_realtime_identified.name: ai_calls_realtime_identified
ai_calls_realtime_identified.value:
("spideryarn"."ai_calls"."realtime_session_id" is null and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."provider_event_id" is null and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."event_kind" is null)
          or ("spideryarn"."ai_calls"."realtime_session_id" is not null and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."provider_event_id" is not null and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."event_kind" is not null)

ai_calls_realtime_columns_need_realtime_.name: ai_calls_realtime_columns_need_realtime_wire
ai_calls_realtime_columns_need_realtime_.value:
"spideryarn"."ai_calls"."wire" = 'realtime' or (
            "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."realtime_session_id" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."provider_status" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."input_text_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."input_audio_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."input_image_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."cached_text_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."cached_audio_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."output_text_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."output_audio_tokens" is null
            and "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."transcription_seconds" is null
          )

ai_calls_costs_not_negative.name: ai_calls_costs_not_negative
ai_calls_costs_not_negative.value:
("spideryarn"."ai_calls"."credits_used_nanos" is null or "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."credits_used_nanos" >= 0)
          and ("spideryarn"."ai_calls"."byok_upstream_nanos" is null or "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."byok_upstream_nanos" >= 0)
          and ("spideryarn"."ai_calls"."computed_cost_nanos" is null or "spideryarn"."ai_calls"."computed_cost_nanos" >= 0)

bibliographic_records_shape.name: bibliographic_records_shape
bibliographic_records_shape.value:
case
            when "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."state" = 'found' then "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."source" is not null and "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."title" is not null
              and length("spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."title") between 1 and 1000
              and "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."authors_family" is not null and "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."doi" is not null and "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."fetched_at" is not null
            when "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."state" = 'not-found' then "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."fetched_at" is not null
              and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."source", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."title", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."authors_family", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."authors_given", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."year", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."venue", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."doi") = 0
            else "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."claimed_until" is not null and "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."fetched_at" is null
              and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."source", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."title", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."authors_family", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."authors_given", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."year", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."venue", "spideryarn"."bibliographic_records"."doi") = 0
          end

billing_accounts_period_order.name: billing_accounts_period_order
billing_accounts_period_order.value: "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."current_period_start" is null or "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."current_period_end" is null or "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."current_period_start" < "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."current_period_end"

billing_accounts_subscription_needs_cust.name: billing_accounts_subscription_needs_customer
billing_accounts_subscription_needs_cust.value: "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."stripe_subscription_id" is null or "spideryarn"."billing_accounts"."stripe_customer_id" is not null

chat_threads_anchor_quote_needs_block.name: chat_threads_anchor_quote_needs_block
chat_threads_anchor_quote_needs_block.value: "spideryarn"."chat_threads"."anchor_quote" is null or "spideryarn"."chat_threads"."anchor_block_id" is not null

citation_finds_lookup_hashes.name: citation_finds_lookup_hashes
citation_finds_lookup_hashes.value: ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_state" is null) = ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_context_hash" is null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_state" is null) = ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_evidence_hash" is null)

citation_finds_lookup_assessed.name: citation_finds_lookup_assessed
citation_finds_lookup_assessed.value: ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_state" is not distinct from 'assessed') = ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_support" is not null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_state" is not distinct from 'assessed') = ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_excerpt_words" is not null)

citation_finds_lookup_paper_does.name: citation_finds_lookup_paper_does
citation_finds_lookup_paper_does.value: ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_paper_does" is null) = ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_paper_does_quote" is null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_paper_does" is null or "spideryarn"."citation_finds"."lookup_support" is not null)

citation_investigations_paper_address.name: citation_investigations_paper_address
citation_investigations_paper_address.value: ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" is not null and "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" <> 'no-address') = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_requested_url" is not null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_requested_url" is not null) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_host" is not null)

citation_investigations_paper_read.name: citation_investigations_paper_read
citation_investigations_paper_read.value: coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_words" is not null) and coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_sent_words" is not null) and coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_chunks" is not null) and coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_matched_by" is not null) and coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_evidence_sha" is not null) and coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_selection_version" is not null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_passages" is null or coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false))

citation_investigations_paper_read_value.name: citation_investigations_paper_read_values
citation_investigations_paper_read_value.value: ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_matched_by" is null or "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_matched_by" in ('doi', 'arxiv', 'title-author')) and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_words" is null or ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_words" >= 0 and "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_sent_words" >= 0 and "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_sent_words" <= "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_words")) and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_evidence_sha" is null or "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_evidence_sha" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_passages" is null or (case when jsonb_typeof("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_passages") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_passages") <= 3 else false end))

citation_investigations_paper_unreadable.name: citation_investigations_paper_unreadable
citation_investigations_paper_unreadable.value: coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'unreadable', false) = ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_unreadable_why" is not null) and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_unreadable_why" is null or "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_unreadable_why" in ('invalid-url', 'blocked', 'refused', 'not-found', 'site-error', 'network', 'timeout', 'too-large', 'not-a-document', 'paywall-or-empty', 'scan', 'damaged'))

citation_investigations_counts.name: citation_investigations_counts
citation_investigations_counts.value: "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."extracts_read" >= 0 and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."extracts_read" >= 1 or coalesce("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."paper_state" = 'read', false)) and "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."longest_extract_words" >= 0 and ("spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."searches" is null or "spideryarn"."citation_investigations"."searches" >= 0)

comments_valence_needs_criterion.name: comments_valence_needs_criterion
comments_valence_needs_criterion.value: "spideryarn"."comments"."valence" is null or "spideryarn"."comments"."criterion_id" is not null

feedback_mirrored_pair.name: feedback_mirrored_pair
feedback_mirrored_pair.value: "spideryarn"."feedback"."sentry_event_id" is null or "spideryarn"."feedback"."mirrored_at" is not null

feedback_mirror_attempted_first.name: feedback_mirror_attempted_first
feedback_mirror_attempted_first.value: "spideryarn"."feedback"."mirrored_at" is null or "spideryarn"."feedback"."mirror_attempted_at" is not null

ingest_events_one_upgrade_in_flight.name: ingest_events_one_upgrade_in_flight
ingest_events_one_upgrade_in_flight.where:
"spideryarn"."ingest_events"."kind" = 'ingest' and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."article_id" is not null
            and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at" is null and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."released_at" is null

ingest_events_settled_after_reserved.name: ingest_events_settled_after_reserved
ingest_events_settled_after_reserved.value:
("spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at" is null or "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at" >= "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."reserved_at")
          and ("spideryarn"."ingest_events"."released_at" is null or "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."released_at" >= "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."reserved_at")

ingest_events_superseded_shape.name: ingest_events_superseded_shape
ingest_events_superseded_shape.value:
"spideryarn"."ingest_events"."superseded_by" is null
          or ("spideryarn"."ingest_events"."kind" = 'minimal' and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at" is not null)

ingest_events_high_power_shape.name: ingest_events_high_power_shape
ingest_events_high_power_shape.value:
"spideryarn"."ingest_events"."kind" <> 'high_power'
          or ("spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at" is not null
              and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."released_at" is null
              and "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."reserved_at" = "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."succeeded_at"
              and ("spideryarn"."ingest_events"."article_id" is not null or "spideryarn"."ingest_events"."article_visibility_at_delete" is not null))

jobs_running_is_fenced.name: jobs_running_is_fenced
jobs_running_is_fenced.value: "spideryarn"."jobs"."status" <> 'running' or ("spideryarn"."jobs"."attempt_id" is not null and "spideryarn"."jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

link_previews_shape.name: link_previews_shape
link_previews_shape.value:
case "spideryarn"."link_previews"."outcome"
            when 'alias' then "spideryarn"."link_previews"."final_target" is not null and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."failure" is null
                        and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."claim_id" is null
                        and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."link_previews"."title", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."site_name", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."description", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."first_paragraph", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."words", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."excerpt") = 0
            when 'ok' then "spideryarn"."link_previews"."final_target" is null and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."failure" is null
                        and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."claim_id" is null
                        and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."link_previews"."title", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."description", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."first_paragraph") > 0
            when 'pending' then "spideryarn"."link_previews"."final_target" is null and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."failure" is null
                        and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."claim_id" is not null
                        and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."link_previews"."title", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."site_name", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."description", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."first_paragraph", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."words", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."excerpt") = 0
            else "spideryarn"."link_previews"."final_target" is null and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."failure" is not null
                        and "spideryarn"."link_previews"."claim_id" is null
                        and num_nonnulls("spideryarn"."link_previews"."title", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."site_name", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."description", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."first_paragraph", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."words", "spideryarn"."link_previews"."excerpt") = 0
          end

link_summaries_shape.name: link_summaries_shape
link_summaries_shape.value:
case "spideryarn"."link_summaries"."status"
            when 'pending' then "spideryarn"."link_summaries"."summary" is null and "spideryarn"."link_summaries"."claim_id" is not null
            else "spideryarn"."link_summaries"."summary" is not null and "spideryarn"."link_summaries"."claim_id" is null
          end

referee_criteria_diverging_shape.name: referee_criteria_diverging_shape
referee_criteria_diverging_shape.value: ("spideryarn"."referee_criteria"."kind" = 'diverging') = ("spideryarn"."referee_criteria"."pole_against" is not null and "spideryarn"."referee_criteria"."pole_favour" is not null and "spideryarn"."referee_criteria"."scale" is not null)

        and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."matched_by" is null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."why" is null)

upload_source_guesses_found.name: upload_source_guesses_found
upload_source_guesses_found.value:
"spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."status" <> 'found' or ("spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."url" is not null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."host" is not null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."kind" is not null
        and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."matched_by" is not null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."why" is null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."claim_token" is null

upload_source_guesses_none.name: upload_source_guesses_none

        and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."kind" is null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."matched_by" is null and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."claim_token" is null
        and "spideryarn"."upload_source_guesses"."finished_at" is not null)

uploads_verified_has_evidence.name: uploads_verified_has_evidence
uploads_verified_has_evidence.value: "spideryarn"."uploads"."status" <> 'verified' or ("spideryarn"."uploads"."sha256" is not null and "spideryarn"."uploads"."bytes" is not null)
